header: 214 of the 300 megawatts we promised are on the grid
text: 214 MW connected, 86 MW to go. Of the 214, 61 MW sit on school and sports-hall roofs the municipalities lease to us for a nominal rent.
note: Counted at the point of grid connection, not at planning approval, and updated when a site is energised. Deadline 31 December 2030. Last updated 31 December 2026.
